//: Controls of the web page under the bar of docs/design/chrome-redesign.md, section 5 (44x44 px on a phone, 24x24 side by side), each with the hit area it has today (test/web-hit-areas.test.ts). Keys are 'where id': where is the page, the panel (its frame), the menu, the settings, the editor header's ⋯ menu (more) or the kind list; a control with no id is keyed by tag, role and first classes, and a family of ids (setting-examples-disabled-*) is one key. Sizes are in CSS px, each dimension at most the bar: only a dimension under the bar is gated. The list may only shrink: a control under the bar that is not listed fails, and so does an entry whose control now meets the bar. Never add an entry by hand for a new control, and never lower a listed size by hand: UPDATE_HIT_AREAS=1 writes the file from the page (with the CJK fonts of CI: FONTCONFIG_FILE), and its diff is reviewed. Rules and details: test/support/hit-areas.ts.
